Yelp New Orleans Restaurant Analysis

A portfolio project in data cleaning, joins, spatial analysis, and reviewer-adjusted ratings

Author

Brandon Lee

Research question

Portfolio README · AI assistance log · Report source

Where can someone find the top 15 restaurants for New Orleans cooking—Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Southern, or Soul Food—in New Orleans, and which geographic area is best for finding them?

Executive summary

Initial analysis covers 672 restaurants and 250,304 reviews in the New Orleans cooking theme. There are no NA values in the retained columns, but seven restaurants have blank street addresses. Published business ratings average 3.82 stars, and available review counts range from 5 to 7,673 per restaurant. The top 15 and best geographic area have not yet been determined.

Data and large-file handling

The import scans the complete Yelp business and review JSON files in pages, filters New Orleans restaurants, and retains only the review columns needed for ratings analysis. It saves compressed RDS files so subsequent analysis does not reload the raw JSON. Filtered reviews are accumulated in memory; this is not a fully disk-backed workflow. Review text and voting fields are omitted. The selected review records span March 14, 2005 through January 19, 2022.

Run Rscript R/analysis.R from the repository root to reproduce the descriptive tables and figures using the saved theme RDS files. This script uses ggplot2. See the restaurant summary, missing-value audit, restaurants with blank addresses, and validation checks.

Restaurant definition and cleaning

Filter to Yelp city New Orleans, state LA, and exact category token Restaurants. Keep both open and closed businesses for the initial historical subset, retain coordinates for later spatial joins, and convert empty postal codes to missing values. See the cleaning code and import code.

Category selection

Selected theme: New Orleans cooking. Include restaurants matching at least one of Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Southern, or Soul Food; count each business once. The planned final ranking contains 15 restaurants. See category selection for counts and co-occurrence evidence.

Initial descriptive results

The filtered theme contains 672 restaurants and 250,304 reviews from 138,848 distinct reviewers. Reviews span 2005-03-14 to 2022-01-19.

Data quality

The missing-value audit found 0 NA values and 7 blank text fields. Details are shown below.

Duplicate-ID, review-linkage, rating-range, coordinate-range, date-parsing, and open-status checks found no issues. Range checks do not establish coordinate accuracy, and absence of missing values does not establish overall accuracy.

Dataset Column NA values Blank fields
restaurants address 0 7

The seven blank street addresses are retained because coordinates are present. They have not been imputed or independently checked; see the exported missing-address table for follow-up.

435 businesses are marked open and 237 marked closed in the historical snapshot. No open-status exclusion has been applied; these flags do not verify current operating status.

Category counts and overlap

Memberships overlap: the four category counts must not be added together. Category means describe the included businesses; they are not independent cuisine comparisons.

Business stars are Yelp’s published business-level values. Mean review stars are recalculated from the available review records; they are separate measures. Each restaurant receives equal weight in the descriptive means above.

Available-review counts differ from the business table’s review_count for 473 restaurants. Both counts are retained separately; threshold comparisons below use actual available review records. The cause of any differences has not been established.

What remains

Choose and justify the restaurant and reviewer eligibility rules, calculate reviewer-adjusted scores, compare ZCTAs and wards using official boundaries, verify seven-area coverage, and select the final top 15. None of the plots or tables above is a final ranking or geographic result.

Geographic comparison

Compare ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs) and New Orleans wards using spatial joins between restaurant coordinates and official boundary polygons. Compare restaurant counts, unmatched locations, ratings, and small-area sample sizes. Use ZCTAs as the geographic approximation of ZIP-code areas rather than assigning areas from Yelp postal codes alone. Verify coverage of at least seven areas before defending the final geographic choice. Boundary assignment and the final choice are pending.

Ratings and reviewer adjustment

Compare raw business ratings with reviewer-adjusted results, establish review-volume criteria, and produce the final top 15 table and a boundary map showing their locations.

Conclusions and limitations

The descriptive results establish the analysis pool and identify blank addresses and uneven review volume. Category memberships overlap, so category averages do not establish independent cuisine effects. Open-status flags and reviews describe a historical snapshot ending in January 2022. Ranking eligibility, reviewer normalization, ZCTA and ward comparisons, a final map, and the top 15 remain unfinished.
